description: Revision-gated AASd-* verdicts (rules added in 3.2, removed before or in 3.x), constraint guards and wording, idShort/JSON-schema facets that are commonly misreported.

items.question: A partner's validator reports 'AASd-138: a SubmodelElementList in a Template submodel must have exactly one element' nine times against an .aasx whose XML declares xmlns="https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/1". Does this finding make the document invalid?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-138 (an SML in a Template submodel or in an OperationVariable shall have exactly one element) is a metamodel 3.2 constraint; it appears in the 3.2 formalisation, not in 3.0 or 3.1. A 3/1 document is judged by the 3.1 rule set, so this is a false invalid.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Template or as part of an operation variable shall have exactly one element.

items.question: Our 3.1 exporter writes an ExternalReference whose second key has Key/type Submodel, and a linter flags it as AASd-137. In which metamodel revision does AASd-137 exist, and should it be applied to a document declaring https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/1?
items.expected_answer: AASd-137 (for external references no key may have a Key/type that is one of the AAS referables) is a 3.2 constraint. It must not be emitted against a 3/1 document; judge the document by its own revision.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Reference/keys shall not be one of AAS referables.

items.question: A 3.1 Range element has valueType xs:double and neither min nor max. A validator reports 'AASd-013: min or max must be defined'. Is the Range invalid?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-013 (a Range with kind=Instance needs min or max or both) was removed in V2.0.1; the Part 1 V3.0 change table 'Changes V2.0.1 vs. V2.0' lists it as Removed. An open-bounds Range is valid; a validator emitting AASd-013 has a stale rule.

citation.section: Annex (Metamodel Changes), Changes V2.0.1 vs. V2.0, Table 42 New, Changed or Removed Constraints w/o Security
citation.quote: AASd-013 Removed Constraint AASd-013: In case of a range with kind=Instance either the min or the max value or both need to be defined.

items.question: Our gate rejects an idShort of 130 characters with the code 'AASd-027'. Is the length limit real, and is AASd-027 the right citation?
items.expected_answer: The 128-character limit is real, but AASd-027 was removed in V3.0: the limit is now carried by the idShort type NameType (maximum length 128), i.e. enforced by the schemas. Cite the schema facet or an internal code, not AASd-027.

citation.section: Annex (Metamodel Changes), Changes V3.0 vs. V3.0RC02, constraint table row AASd-027
citation.quote: AASd-027 Removed Not needed any longer since Type of idShort was changed to NameType and NameType has a maximum length of 128 characters

items.question: In an AAS 3.0 document (xmlns https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/0) a Property carries category="MEASUREMENT". Does this violate a numbered constraint in 3.0, and which values would be allowed?
items.expected_answer: Yes, in 3.0: AASd-090 says that for data elements category shall be one of CONSTANT, PARAMETER or VARIABLE, so MEASUREMENT violates it in a 3.0 document.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: of the following values: CONSTANT, PARAMETER or VARIABLE.

items.question: In an AAS 3.0 document, the direct children of a SubmodelElementList carry idShorts (Marking001, Marking002). Which numbered rule applies in 3.0?
items.expected_answer: AASd-120 (3.0): the idShort of submodel elements being a direct child of a SubmodelElementList shall not be specified, so in a 3.0 document those idShorts are a violation.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Constraint AASd-120: ID-short of submodel elements being a direct child of a

items.question: Against the official AAS 3.1 XSD, which of these idShorts are rejected: 'Motor-1', 'M', 'Motor_', 'Motor-'?
items.expected_answer: 'M' is rejected (the 3.1 pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*[a-zA-Z0-9_]+ needs at least two characters) and 'Motor-' is rejected (it may not end with a hyphen). 'Motor-1' and 'Motor_' are valid: a mid-string hyphen is allowed in 3.1.

items.question: A 3.1 Property has valueType xs:int and value 'abc'. Our validator reports it as 'AASd-020'. Is AASd-020 the right constraint id?
items.expected_answer: No. In 3.1 AASd-020 is the Qualifier rule (Qualifier/value consistent with Qualifier/valueType). The Property mismatch is still a violation, but of the unnumbered Property invariant 'Value must be consistent with the value type', so cite it with an internal code, not AASd-020.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Constraint AASd-020: The value shall be consistent to the data type as defined

items.question: A 3.1 SubmodelElementList declares no semanticIdListElement, and every child carries the same semanticId. Does AASd-107 fire?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-107 only requires a child's semanticId to equal semanticIdListElement when the list declares a semanticIdListElement; with none declared there is nothing to compare. (AASd-114 still needs the children's semanticIds to be identical, and here they are.)

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.section: Constraint AASd-107 (invariant of class Submodel_element_list, guard on semantic_ID_list_element)

items.question: A 3.1 SubmodelElementList declares typeValueListElement=SubmodelElement, holds Property children, and has no valueTypeListElement. Is that an AASd-109 violation?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-109 applies only when typeValueListElement is Property or Range; then valueTypeListElement shall be set and all children share it. A list declaring SubmodelElement is outside the rule, whatever its children are.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Property or Range value type list element shall be set

items.question: Two sibling elements in the same SubmodelElementCollection are named 'Voltage' and 'voltage'. Is that an idShort uniqueness (AASd-022) violation in 3.1?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-022 requires idShorts of non-identifiable referables to be unique within the same name space case-sensitively, so 'Voltage' and 'voltage' are distinct.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: within the same name space shall be unique (case-sensitive).

items.question: The .aas.json part of a 3.1 package contains "submodels": [] (an empty array) while the .aas.xml part validates. Is the JSON schema-valid?
items.expected_answer: No. The official 3.1 JSON schema gives Environment.submodels "minItems": 1, so an empty array is invalid; omit the key instead.

items.question: A File element in a document declaring https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/1 has a value but no contentType. Does the official 3.1 XSD reject it?
items.expected_answer: No. In the 3.1 XSD the File contentType element is minOccurs="0", i.e. optional; omitting it is schema-valid.

items.question: An AssetAdministrationShell's assetInformation has assetKind=Instance but neither globalAssetId nor any specificAssetId. The XSD passes. Is the shell valid?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-131 requires that either the globalAssetId is defined or at least one specificAssetId; an XSD pass does not cover it.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Either the global asset ID shall be defined or at least one

items.question: A validator reports AASd-120 (idShort on a direct child of a SubmodelElementList) on an AAS 3.1 document. Is that a real violation?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-120 was removed in V3.1 (change note: idShort also allowed for elements within a SubmodelElementList, #432). It applies to 3.0 documents only; on 3.1 it is a false invalid.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (official PDF, paged text)
citation.quote: REMOVED: remove AASd-120: idShort also allowed for elements within a SubmodelElementList (#432)
